headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: The second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera is on sale at Amazon. It's bundled with a 16-photo film pack for $71.99. This price is the lowest seen for the package.

headline: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
summary: Matt Groening hinted at a return for The Simpsons: Hit & Run game. He stated the original game might come back 'in some form.' Showrunner Matt Selman added uncertainty, but body language suggested a comeback.

headline: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
summary: 'Your AI Slop Bores Me' is a simple game for roleplaying as an AI chatbot. Users submit requests and answers, with a human on both sides. It offers a humorous way to interact with and critique AI-generated content.

headline: Don't overlook Elektron's budget electronic music instruments
summary: Elektron's budget Model:Samples and Model:Cycles are recommended for electronic music beginners. These grooveboxes offer a more affordable entry into music production. They are often overlooked compared to flashier or higher-end gear.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More (Updating Live!)
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase, 'Horizons: A Carousel of Progress,' is taking place in Anaheim. It covers major news for Disney Parks worldwide and Disney Cruise Line. Live updates are being provided on all announcements.

headline: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 co-director Tai Yasue and Tetsuya Nomura assured fans. They confirmed the game will '100%' not be delayed. The late 2027 launch window is firmly set.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 was revealed at D23 2026. The trailer showcased playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy for the first time. The reveal happened during the 'Deep Dive into Kingdom Hearts' panel.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Lets You Keep Helping Hondo Ohnaka in Fortnite After You Leave Disneyland
summary: 'Smuggler's Gambit' integrates the 'Smuggler's Run' experience into Fortnite. It's a PvE multiplayer game allowing players to continue helping Hondo Ohnaka. Linking Epic Games and MyDisney accounts unlocks a special park experience.

headline: Reform UK plan would overhaul welfare system with £50bn in savings
summary: Reform UK proposes an overhaul of the welfare system. The plan aims for £50 billion in savings. A 50-page detailed plan is expected to be released Monday.

headline: Major incidents across UK putting firefighters under 'incredible pressure', fire chief says
summary: Major incidents have been declared across England and Wales. Firefighters are under 'incredible pressure' due to numerous blazes. Fires are notably affecting areas like Stourbridge, Sandwell, and Pershore.

headline: Ariana Grande leaves problems at home as her tour hits the UK
summary: Ariana Grande's tour has commenced its UK leg. She is playing the first of 10 dates in London. The star plans to 'step back' from public life after the tour.

headline: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM
summary: The death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday is described as a 'tragedy.' The Prime Minister expressed his sorrow. Andy Burnham called it a 'really sad, sad and sorry state of affairs.'
